item.title: Simplifying the Landscape of NIH Clinical Trial Funding Opportunities
item.description: As part of evolving efforts to simplify the landscape of Notices of Funding Opportunity (NOFOs), NIH is developing a suite of broad clinical trial NOFOs organized around different types of clinical trials rather than specific diseases or scientific topics.
